The fixture `tabular_zm_1_2026.pdf` is the public, unmodified PDF from
https://www.litovel.eu/filemanager/files/file.php?file=5228013.

It contains 12 adopted resolutions from Litovel's council meeting on
2 November 2026, numbered `UZ-1-1/26` through `UZ-12-1/26`.
The three-page table includes overlaid bold characters and separate voting,
responsibility, deadline and completion columns. Its footer contains a different
date, so the parser must use the meeting-date column.

The unmodified public fixture
`schvalena_usneseni_z_1.schuze_rady_mesta_litovel_konane_dne_12._listopadu_2026.pdf`
comes from https://www.litovel.eu/filemanager/files/file.php?file=5240490.
It contains 32 adopted council resolutions, `UR-1-1/26` through `UR-32-1/26`,
in a nine-page table with only identifier and decision-text columns. Several
decisions continue on the next page. The meeting date (12 November 2026) comes
from the notice title preserved in the filename by the synchronizer; the footer
and PDF metadata instead contain the generation date (20 November 2026).
